top_strength: Calvin nailed the quid pro quo framing upfront and delivered a clear, personalized estimate anchored to typical ranges, then modified it based on the customer's specific items—that's strong discovery-to-estimate flow.
coaching_note: After the agenda question, you got 'no real concerns' but never dug deeper—ask 'what about [floor access / parking / fragile items / timing constraints]' to uncover hidden concerns and earn the takeaway; also, Communication (day-before call, crew lead name, inbox updates) was never mentioned anywhere on the call, and 'Meet Your Mover' was skipped entirely—both belong in Stage 2 as takeaway items if not raised organically.
